name: txiki.js
reason: No source claims txiki.js is faster than any baseline, and the only numbers found show it not faster. README (opened) says 'small and powerful', built on QuickJS-ng and libuv, with no performance claim. benchmark/ holds only hashing.js (native mbedtls hashing versus npm JS hash packages, printed at run time, no stored results; the commit that added it is 'hashing: replace JS implementation with mbedtls based one', 2026-03-03) and million-timers.js (no baseline). The one third-party suite that includes it, ahaoboy/js-engine-benchmark (v8-v7 suite, nightly run of 10/5/2026 on GitHub-hosted runners, CPU not stated), scores txiki.js 819 on Ubuntu versus QuickJS 1217 (slower), quickjs-ng 647 (ahead, but txiki.js embeds quickjs-ng so this is a build difference) and Hermes 1530 (slower); on macOS arm64 txiki.js scores 1218 versus QuickJS 1761 and quickjs-ng 1660 (slower than both); its footprint there is 4.1M versus QuickJS 1M. The same pattern as the Duktape and JsonCpp no-evidence records. If the orchestrator wants a not-faster record, the rows to use are the Ubuntu and macOS arm64 tables in https://github.com/ahaoboy/js-engine-benchmark (59 stars, nightly CI commits through 2026-10-05). txiki.js itself: MIT, 3.2k stars, last commit 2026-10-01.

name: Veles
listed_description: Distributed platform for rapid Deep learning application development.
reason: No numeric comparison anywhere reachable. README (opened) names only the components (platform, Znicz neural network engine, Mastodon Java bridge, SoundFeatureExtraction) and the Apache-2.0 licence, with no performance claim; 'rapid' refers to development speed. Repo tree (cuda, ocl, libVeles, veles, docs, web) has no benchmark directory; the docs index and manualrst_veles_intro, algorithms, ocl, advanced, distributed_training pages contain no timings (algorithms.rst only mentions a cifar_caffe_config.py example file); issue search for 'benchmark' returns 0 results (35 issues total); veles.znicz README has none either. Web search for Veles against Caffe, Theano or TensorFlow found only general framework comparisons (arXiv 1511.06435 and others) that do not include Veles; project site velesnet.ml not opened. Repo: 916 stars, last commit 2023-11-21 (docs link cleanup, otherwise idle since about 2016).
